title: Estimation and Model Selection in Factor Models with Long Memory
abstract: arXiv:2611.22289v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Panels in economics, finance and climate science are often driven by common components that differ in memory, such as common trends, cycles, or joint shocks. We study approximate factor models whose common factors are fractionally integrated with heterogeneous and unknown memory and develop the asymptotic theory of principal components for the panel in levels. Our theory builds on the eigenvalues of the sample covariance matrix being ordered by memory asymptotically: a nonstationary factor group with memory $d>1/2$ generates eigenvalues of order $NT^{2d-1}$, whereas stationary factors generate eigenvalues of order $N$. Principal components estimate the factors consistently up to rotation, while adjacent factor groups are separated at a rate given by their memory gap. translated_title: 长记忆因子模型中的估计与模型选择
translated_abstract: 经济学、金融学和气候科学中的面板数据常常由具有不同记忆性的共同成分所驱动，例如共同趋势、周期或联合冲击。我们研究了近似因子模型，其共同因子为分数积分过程，具有异质且未知的记忆参数，并针对面板的水平值数据建立了主成分估计的渐近理论。我们的理论建立在样本协方差矩阵特征值按记忆性渐近排序的基础之上：记忆参数 $d>1/2$ 的非平稳因子组会产生 $NT^{2d-1}$ 阶的特征值，而平稳因子则产生 $N$ 阶的特征值。主成分在允许旋转的意义下一致地估计因子，而相邻因子组按其记忆差距所给定的速率实现分离。Bai 和 Ng 的信息准则对于因子总数依然保持一致性，其惩罚项起到对特征值设定阈值的作用。
tldr: 该论文为共同因子具有异质未知长记忆参数的近似因子模型建立了主成分估计的渐近理论，证明样本协方差矩阵的特征值按记忆性渐近排序，且 Bai-Ng 信息准则仍能一致地确定因子总数。
en_tdlr: This paper develops the asymptotic theory of principal components for approximate factor models with common factors of heterogeneous unknown long memory, showing that eigenvalues of the sample covariance matrix are ordered by memory and that Bai-Ng information criteria remain consistent for the total number of factors.
